messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Energy, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear RydeQuest Team,

Your retained executive-search work across the GCC, including senior leadership in energy, utilities, government and sovereign-linked organisations, aligns closely with my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy and strategic partnerships. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
